status: Both complete original DDraw1/2 multiple-device groups pass; DDraw2 crash is fixed; overall Wine acceptance still fails.
changes: Allocate an independent protocol drawing context for every legacy D3D device. Surface/texture/buffer storage remains on the DirectDraw resource owner. Contexts explicitly have no presentation surface and are destroyed independently.
Track all active D3D devices per owner; creation failures preserve siblings, and middle/head/tail release unlinks only that context. Depth attachment and flip rebinding update every affected context.

Material handles are stable per device and resolve their shared material data across live owners. Material updates reach every bound context; device/material teardown removes aliases. Texture handles keep global identity; swapping requires both handles and refreshes bound legacy contexts while retaining the cached numeric values.

D3D1 matrix handles are looked up across live contexts, including foreign owners; Set/Get/Delete share the creator allocation and unlink it correctly. Existing creator cleanup remains. D3D7 retains its own texture-owner restriction.
